source_review.notes: Checked Hohpe/Woolf and the Enterprise Integration Patterns site, current Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ official documentation, CloudEvents and AsyncAPI specifications, Kleppmann, Richardson, and NIST SP 800-207. Product delivery/order/confirmation claims are scoped to current primary documentation; end-to-end guidance states its premises.

evidence: Checked envelope tuple, channel Q/F/Z/L state, publish/delivery/effect/confirmation counts, backlog recurrence, and arrival/completion notation.
Confirmed acknowledgement semantics and time/ordering scopes are defined rather than assumed.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Abstract channel notation does not claim one product's internal state machine.

evidence: Reproduced capacity-two admission: two accepted, third backpressured.
Recomputed m-1 attempts from one to two across requeue and final queued/in-flight/effect counts 1/0/1.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The trace has no concurrent attempts, retention clock, bytes, or rate calculation.

evidence: Checked P_m>=1, D_m>=1, E_m=1 separates transport attempts from effect cardinality and requires an application identity/effect boundary.
Checked backlog recurrence and instability conclusion when long-run arrivals exceed sustainable completions without governed exits.
Derived crash-window outcomes in Answer 1 from transaction/confirm/ack ordering.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No unconditional loss-free, liveness, global order, or exactly-once theorem is asserted.

evidence: Reviewed producer dual write and confirm uncertainty; consumer pre/post effect/ack crashes; duplicates, loss, poison data, retry, quarantine, expiry, redrive, cancellation, and remote-effect uncertainty.

Reviewed point-to-point/pub-sub/log, partition order/skew/reshard, rebalance, backpressure/downstream saturation, schema semantic change/replay, tenant/actor trust, payload privacy, oversized/deserialization input, broker outage, and high-stakes late clinical alert.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real broker topology, database, network, workload, security, regulation, and clinical evidence remain required.

evidence: Traced purpose/ownership, transactional publication, confirm/ack separation, post-effect ack, scoped ordering, capacity, durable envelope, security, compatibility, and observability through exposition/examples/answers.
Checked finite queue capacity, in-flight ownership, redelivery attempt increment, and one local processed identity.
invariant_checking.notes: The in-memory processed set is not durable or atomic with an effect and is labeled accordingly.

evidence: Reviewed admission, first delivery, requeue, redelivery, dedupe, acknowledgement, and final-state trace against code order.
Reviewed safety/liveness premise separation and counterexamples involving crash after external effect, early ack, absent outbox, retention expiry, permanent poison, and partition reordering.
proof_review.notes: No broker persistence, distributed transaction, thread safety, performance, security, or clinical proof is claimed.

evidence: Audited guaranteed, durable, exactly once, ordered, delivered, confirmed, acknowledged, completed, safe, loss, proof, and conclusion language.
Confirmed every strong end-to-end claim names outbox/inbox, identity, transaction, broker configuration, availability, retention, and human-review premises as applicable.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Broker/product mechanisms are not generalized beyond their documented scope.

evidence: Recorded that no broker, network, disk, replica, database transaction, concurrency, auth, schema registry, or load was executed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution establishes one deterministic in-memory trace only.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter distinguishes logical channels, point-to-point, publish-subscribe, queues/logs, publisher confirms, consumer acknowledgements, delivery/effect semantics, partition order, outbox/inbox, retry/quarantine, and request-reply without collapsing product terminology.

practitioner_review.notes: Guidance covers intent/topology, producer and consumer atomic boundaries, delivery claims, order/partitioning, capacity/backpressure, retry/dead letter, envelopes/schema, security, request-reply, telemetry, reconciliation, and real crash/load/recovery testing.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with formal delivery/backlog notation, a runnable redelivery model, ten distinct examples, and five complete exercises spanning crash traces, partition design, seven-year schema retention, operational remediation, and clinical transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
